title: Right to Expedient Disposal of Complaint

content.scenario: A consumer, Ms. Patel, files a complaint against a manufacturer for a defective refrigerator. The complaint requires analysis and testing of the product to determine the cause of the defect. The consumer forum takes up the case and, within five months, completes the necessary analysis and testing, and then rules in favor of Ms. Patel, ordering the manufacturer to replace the defective product.
content.outcome: Ms. Patel's complaint is disposed of expeditiously within the timeframe allowed for complaints requiring analysis or testing of commodities, upholding her right to expedient disposal of her complaint.
